# API Ninjas

API Ninjas offers over 120 unique APIs across various categories, enabling developers to build real applications with real data.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/api-ninjas/.

## Actions

- **BIN Lookup**: Look up bank information from a bank identification number.
- **Check Disposable Email**: Check whether an email address is from a disposable email provider.
- **Commodity Price**: Get real-time price for a commodity.
- **Crypto Price**: Get real-time price for a cryptocurrency pair.
- **DNS Lookup**: Retrieve dns records for a specified domain.
- **Earnings Calendar**: Fetch past and upcoming earnings results for a specified ticker.
- **Earnings Call Transcript**: Get the earnings call transcript for a company and quarter.
- **ETF Info**: Get detailed information about an etf by ticker.
- **Extract Nutrition Information**: Extract nutrition information from text query.
- **Generate Barcode Image**: Generate a barcode image for specified text.
- **Get Bitcoin Price and Market Data**: Retrieve the latest bitcoin price and 24-hour market data.
- **Get Inflation Data**: Get current inflation data for a country.
- **IBAN Lookup**: Look up and validate an international bank account number (iban).
- **Income Tax**: Get current and historical income tax rates for a country.
- **Income Tax Calculator**: Calculate income taxes for us and canada.
- **Interest Rate**: Get current interest rates for central banks and benchmarks.
- **Market Cap**: Get real-time market cap data for a company.
- **Mortgage Rate**: Get current and historical mortgage rates.
